record_type_quote: Children's Judgments of Durations: A Modified Replication of Piaget's Study

targets.title: The child's conception of time
targets.evidence_quote: It was found that correct judgments about durations were not made before eighth grade (the criterion being 75% of the eighth graders giving correct answers). This grade level was considerably later than the age of 7 or 8 (second grade) that Piaget reported.
